basic_details.short_information: Central Bank of India Samajik Utthan Avam Prashikshan Sansthan (CBI-SUAPS) is engaging 5 people on a one-year contract at its RSETI (Rural Self Employment Training Institute) in Alipurduar: 2 Faculty at a contract amount of Rs.30000/- per month, 2 Office Assistants at Rs.20000/- per month and 1 Attendant at Rs.14000/- per month, for the year 2026-27. The age limit for all three posts is 22-40 years with sound health. Applications in the Annexure format must be received by 15.12.2026 at the Regional Office of Central Bank of India, Coochbehar.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 5 vacancies in total for one centre. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: For each post the notice states that no other allowance, benefit, payment or facility will be admissible. The candidate shall be appointed on contract basis for a period of one year. Renewal of contract may be considered at the sole discretion of the Society/Trust and subject to satisfactory performance. No person employed elsewhere will be allowed to work on the advertised post after being selected for the contractual engagement. Leave: 12 CL per year on pro rata basis and 10 PL for completed year of active service.

content_sections.heading: CBI-SUAPS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The functioning of the Faculty shall be broadly to assist the Director in conducting Training and Awareness Programmes, Generation of Application and Selection of Candidate, Preparation of Annual Action Plan, Logistics for Training Programme, Handling Sessions, Preparation of Notes and similar other activities of the centre. Assisting the Director and Faculty in functioning of the institute. Maintaining Accounts, Vouchers, Books/Registers, Updating data, Periodicals Reports, Follow up and similar other activities of the Centre. Generally all subordinate work of the Institute including up keeping of office premises, classrooms, dormitory, bathrooms etc. and any other work entrusted by the Director from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for personal interview, and the decision of the Society/Trust in this regard shall be final. An applicant may apply for a specific Centre, but the organisation reserves the right to assign the applicant to a nearby centre as per requirement and availability. The notice gives no interview date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CBI-SUAPS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the given format (Annexure-IV) for the RSETI Centre at Alipurduar, stating the post applied for. Subscribe the application "Application for the post of Faculty/Office Assistant/Attendant at RSETI Alipurduar on contract for the FY year 2026-27". Address it to Regional Manager/Co-Chairman, Dist. Level RSETI Advisory Committee (DLRAC), Central Bank of India, Regional Office Coochbehar, Bangchatra Road, Coochbehar, WB-736101. Faculty applicants attach a self-attested copy of the service certificate from the previous employer, or of experience as Faculty, Rural Development; the original is to be produced at the time of interview. The application must be received by 15.12.2026. No applications will be entertained beyond that date, and incomplete applications will be rejected. The application form asks for name, address, disability details if any, date of birth, contact details, educational qualification, present employment details and two references. Faculty applicants also give relevant experience, and retired officials give retirement details. It ends with a declaration and the applicant's signature. The notice states that there is no application fee prescribed.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Passport size photograph pasted on the form and signed across (the form has two photograph spaces). Copies of educational certificates, attested by self or any Gazetted officer. Faculty: self-attested copy of service certificate of previous employer or experience as Faculty, Rural Development, from the organisation or institution concerned. Self-attested letter or certificate of the employer, institution or organisation for details of present employment. The form has a numbered Enclosures list for the documents attached.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CBI-SUAPS Recruitment 2026 at RSETI Alipurduar?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 2 Faculty, 2 Office Assistant (OA) and 1 Attendant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 15.12.2026. No applications will be entertained beyond that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Faculty?
faq.answer: The Faculty must be a Graduate (any i.e. Science/Commerce/Arts/Post Graduate) with a flair for teaching and sound computer knowledge. Preference is given to MSW, MA in Rural Dev., MA in Sociology, Psychology and some other degrees listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Office Assistant and Attendant?
faq.answer: The Office Assistant must be a Graduate viz. BSW/BA/B.Com with computer knowledge. The Attendant must be a Matriculate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 22-40 years with sound health for Faculty, Office Assistant and Attendant. The application form asks for age in completed years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The contract amount is Rs.30000/- per month for Faculty, Rs.20000/- for Office Assistant and Rs.14000/- for Attendant. No other allowance, benefit, payment or facility is admissible.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notice states that there is no application fee prescribed.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the Annexure format, with the subject line printed in the notice, to the Regional Manager/Co-Chairman (DLRAC), Central Bank of India, Regional Office Coochbehar, Bangchatra Road, Coochbehar, WB-736101, so that it is received by 15.12.2026.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for personal interview, and the decision of the Society/Trust is final.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement for one year, and renewal may be considered at the sole discretion of the Society/Trust, subject to satisfactory performance.
